en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1926 - It is narrated from Isa ibn Abi Mansur, who said:

"I was with Abu Abdullah (as) on the day when people were uncertain (whether it was the first of Month of Ramadan or not).
Imam (as) said: 'O boy, go and see whether the Amir (ruler) has fasted or not.'
The boy went and returned, saying: ''No, he has not fasted.'
Then Imam (as) called for lunch, and we ate with him."
